title: Italian Banana Fritters
description: A twist on traditional Italian dough fritters, these banana fritters are a delicious dessert inspired by Greek cuisine.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, yeast, and salt.
2. In a separate bowl, mash bananas and mix with eggs, sugar, and oil.
3. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
4. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let the dough rest in a warm place for 1 hour.
5. Heat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
6. Using a spoon, drop small balls of dough into the oil.
7. Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
8. Remove the fritters from oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate.
9. Drizzle loukoumades syrup over the fritters while still warm.
